scope: Theorem 3.2 (Polynomial shortcut bound) of the manuscript “The strong thin tree conjecture” (preprints/The-strong-thin-tree-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 174 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a2b847ce72f66109), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an absolute integer qH ≥ 2 such that the following holds for each integer q ≥ qH. Let H have a locally q-connected hierarchy, and let ℳ be any collection of its nonroot nodes satisfying |O(A)| ≥ |P(A)|/q. Then H has a shortcut matrix D such that (3.2) 1 |O(A)| ∑ e∈O(A) RD(e) ≤ q−31/40 (A ∈ ℳ). The cutoff is independent of the graph, the hierarchy depth and the marked collection ℳ.
